idConventions.C25Y12-*, B25Y12-*: 2025 Year 12 ledger IDs; the ledgers chem-new-y12.json and bio-new-y12.json use the same C25-/B25- prefix as Year 11, so Y12 is added here to avoid a clash
idConventions.P25Y12-*: PROVISIONAL. No phys-new-y12 ledger exists. Numbered in order from the site transcription teaching-app-fix/docs/science syllabi/physics-11-12-2025-content.md (transcribed 15-16 June 2026, formulas blank). Not official codenames.

Includes the 'net inward force removed' scene (CM-06).

Banked tracks are absent from 2025 and are only a 'for example' case in 2017 P5-IQ2-02. Lowest voicing priority in the whole set; consider not voicing. Incline normal-force art can serve phys-y11-fa1-v21 to v23.

Practical support.

Two narration lines say 'the syllabus calls/asks'; make label-free before voicing. CP-11 asks for a four-way comparison (masses, satellites, E fields, B fields); the design compares with other circular motion only.
Velocity selector. 2025 asks for mass spectrometers and electron guns (CP-12); the design mentions both but does not teach their functions. Add a scene or a short gap video.
Narration 'syllabus writes as F equals l I perpendicular B': make label-free.

Parallel wires and the ampere definition (2017 P6-IQ2-02, 03) have no 2025 home. The single-wire field half (grip rule, B = mu0 I / 2 pi r) is 2025 Year 11 content: art and sims can feed phys-y11-fa3-v24, v25.
2025 defines theta to the area vector (normal), as the design already does. Remove the 'syllabus also writes B parallel A' line before voicing.
Mutual induction supports AP-02 (why the primary needs AC).
High-voltage transmission (2017 P6-IQ3-05) is not a 2025 point. The P = I^2 R line-loss scenes could serve phys-y11-fa3-v17 as art.

Formula convention: the design uses tau = nIAB sin(theta) (2017 data sheet); 2025 writes tau = nBIA cos(theta) with a different angle. Settle the angle wording before voicing so one take serves both. Check that slip rings and AC motors (ME-09) are covered.
Brushless DC motor (AP-07) is a 2025 addition not in the design; one narration line says 'syllabus asks'.
Design already covers c = 1/sqrt(epsilon0 mu0) and Hertz. Production and propagation scenes could also be re-cut for phys-y11-fa2-v13.
Historical methods (Romer, Fizeau). 2025 replaces 2017 P7-IQ1-03 with a school measurement of c and an accuracy assessment. Mostly 2017-only.
